task_instance: Generate a full developer handoff spec (visual specs, design tokens, component props, interaction states, responsive breakpoints, edge cases, animation, accessibility) for a 'Toast Notification' React+Tailwind component, working from a written design description (no Figma URL/connector available offline).
evidence: Created design-description.md as the input design brief (a toast notification component: layout, stacking, auto-dismiss, variants, mobile behavior). Produced handoff-spec.md following the skill's exact output template, filling every required section: Overview, Layout, Design Tokens Used, Components, States and Interactions, Responsive Behavior, Edge Cases, Animation/Motion, Accessibility Notes -- using named tokens (spacing-md, color-success, radius-md, etc.) rather than bare values per the skill's 'use tokens, not values' principle, and covering default/hover/focus/active/loading-equivalent states, 3 breakpoints, 7 edge cases (empty, long text, i18n, slow connections, missing data, overflow, duplicates), 5 animation rows, and 7 accessibility notes (ARIA roles, live regions, focus order, keyboard, WCAG timing). Verified programmatically with a python script (run in the work dir) confirming: (1) all 10 required '### <Section>' headings from the skill's template are present in the output, and (2) all 5 markdown tables are well-formed (each row has the same column count as its header, correctly accounting for escaped pipe characters inside cell content). This is a pure text/document-generation deliverable -- the skill's core task (drafting a spec from a description) needs no network, no installed extra tools, and no Figma/tracker connector; the skill document itself states it falls back to 'the provided description or screenshot' when no Figma URL is given, which is exactly the path exercised here. Files produced: design-description.md, handoff-spec.md, result.json, all under the work directory.
